    <div>
      <h1>Pilot Selection and Scope Contract</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A signed contract naming the pilot teams, bounded workstream, sponsor and lead, and pre-pilot baseline.</p>
      <p style="font-weight:700">Select pilot teams that are representative, not exceptional</p>
      <p><i>The pilot team includes your three best developers and a greenfield project. The pilot succeeds brilliantly. Nothing learned transfers to a team of mixed seniority working on a legacy codebase.</i> <span class="prior-src">ch08 L247</span></p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-08-pilot-selection-and-scope</b><br>
      Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>
      fill order <b>9</b> &middot; type <b>decision</b><br>
      audience <b>mixed</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Phase 1: Pilot (1–5 months)</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L114-120 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-phase-1-pilot">#sec-transition-phase-1-pilot</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Use the completed readiness assessments and the risk-register hero-pilot score; check your selected teams against WS-08-transition-roadmap and that score against your field 7 justifications. Record every candidate team, compare each against your organization's norm, and select no more than two. For every selected team, explain in writing why the work will transfer even if a rating is somewhat atypical or exceptional; give every unselected team a reason. Bound one workstream and name what is out of scope. Record all four Month 0 measures and their sources before any tooling is provisioned; if a measure cannot be captured, write “not measurable” and name its substitute. Plan the minimum viable context layer inside Phase 1. Complete the phase-entry and checkpoint-readiness annexes (sheets 2 and 3), then sign this contract in the room. Record the selected phase, budget, owner and target date in the Phase 1 commitment block above the signature.
    <br><b>Prerequisites:</b> WS-06-team-readiness-scorecard and WS-08-pitfall-risk-register.
    <b>Feeds:</b> WS-08-transition-planning-checklist, WS-08-phase-gate-exit-rollback and WS-08-baseline-measurement-plan.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>F. Phase entry <span class="ws-block-note">the eight-phase decision matrix and evidence</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:10%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:17%">
        <col style="width:15%"><col style="width:11%"><col style="width:15%"><col style="width:7%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead><tr>
        <th><span class="fno">25</span> Lifecycle phase</th><th><span class="fno">26</span> “Start here if…”</th>
        <th><span class="fno">27</span> True of us</th><th><span class="fno">28</span> First investment</th>
        <th><span class="fno">29</span> Maturity prerequisite</th><th><span class="fno">30</span> Present / partial / absent</th>
        <th><span class="fno">31</span> Evidence for that claim</th><th><span class="fno">32</span> Expected timeline</th>
      </tr></thead>

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div><h1>Annex — Checkpoint Readiness</h1><p class="ws-sub">Measure test readiness per repository and decide whether the checkpoint can run after every wave.</p></div>
    <div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-pilot-selection-and-scope</b><br>Block G &middot; Annex<br>Sheet 3 of 3</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-source">Checkpoint source: <b>Checkpoint Discipline</b>, <code>handbook\ch18-the-execution-meta-process.qmd</code> L216-236 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch18-the-execution-meta-process.html#sec-meta-checkpoints">#sec-meta-checkpoints</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Complete one record per repository the pilot will touch. Measure runtime and flake rate; record coverage of the pilot workstream, not global coverage. Define the gate and sampling rule. If the verdict is no, name the remediation and its cost here and carry it to WS-08-transition-planning-checklist as a task with an owner and date.</div>

        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">40</span></td><td><b>G. Checkpoint readiness — Flake rate</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>

        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">47</span></td><td><b>G. Checkpoint readiness — Verdict: can we afford to run this after every wave?</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">yes</span><span class="opt">no</span></div></td></tr>
